About us

A quiet room built
around one perfect spoon.

Velvet Spoon began as a two-burner kitchen experiment in blackberry gelato and never really left it. Today our team churns, folds and plates everything in-house — cream from a single dairy, fruit from growers we know by name, and a 24-karat leaf finish on the desserts that deserve it.

Nothing is pre-made, nothing is rushed. We make fewer things and we make them beautifully.

11Years churning
38Seasonal flavours
